results.releaseNotes:
Sunrise Sunset Tracker just got even better!

New
• Track golden hour and blue hour with precise times and optional notifications, so you never miss the perfect light.
• Instantly compare today's daylight with yesterday to see how the days are changing.

Improved
• Sunrise, sunset, and daylight times now automatically follow your device's 12- or 24-hour clock preference.
• Home Screen widgets are more reliable and remain clear in both Clear and Tinted styles.
• Better support for midnight sun and polar night in northern locations.

Fixed
• Restored the missing sun marker in arc widgets.
• Fixed an issue where multiple notifications could prevent some alerts from being scheduled correctly.

As always, we've also made performance improvements and squashed bugs to keep Sunrise Sunset Tracker fast, accurate, and reliable wherever your adventures take you.
results.description:
Plan your days, hikes, trips, and outdoor moments around the sun. Whether you are chasing the golden hour glow, heading off-grid on a trail, or keeping track of seasonal daylight changes, Sunrise & Sunset Tracker gives you clean, precise solar data anywhere in the world—no internet connection required.

Designed for travelers, hikers, outdoor enthusiasts, and everyday sunset lovers, this elegant solar companion provides instant clarity on solar timing, light phases, and daylight duration.

KEY FEATURES
Offline Solar Calculations: Get accurate sunrise, sunset, twilight, and golden hour times anywhere on Earth—even deep off-grid without cellular signal.

Interactive Solar Map: Tap anywhere on the globe to inspect sun times, plan future travel itineraries, or check daylight windows for upcoming outdoor trips.

Golden Hour & Twilight Timing: Precise breakdown of civil, nautical, and astronomical twilight, plus golden hour and blue hour windows.

Daily Daylight Tracker: See exact daylight duration and monitor daily shifts (today vs. yesterday) as seasons change.

Extreme Latitude Support: Reliable solar math that adapts seamlessly to polar night and midnight sun phenomena near the poles.

Smart Solar Alerts: Set custom notifications for sunrise, sunset, or golden hour so you never miss the best light of the day.

Home Screen Widgets: Quick-glance solar timing directly on your lock and home screens with support for clear and tinted iOS widget styles.

Tailored Display Options: Seamless support for 12-hour and 24-hour time formats, adapting automatically to your preferred region settings.

BUILT FOR THE OUTDOORS & EVERYDAY LIFE
Hikers & Campers: Know exactly how much daylight remains before dark so you can manage your trail pace and campsite setup safely.

Travelers & Road Trippers: Check local sun times at your next destination to plan scenic stops, evening dinners, or early morning departures.

Golden Hour Chasers: Capture beautiful casual photos, videos, and twilight views at the exact right moment.

Daily Rhythms: Align your morning runs, outdoor routines, or gardening schedules with natural sunlight.

Never guess when darkness falls or when the light turns golden. Download Sunrise & Sunset Tracker and take accurate solar timing wherever you roam.
